value.name: Lucia secures the door
value.description: Lucia waits for Asha to come fully inside, then closes the door behind them, cutting off Daniel's voice.
evidence: At the threshold Lucia waited for her to come fully inside before she set her hand on the door, and the small click of the latch behind them was quieter than Daniel's voice had been but did more to the house.

value.name: Asha realizes the key opens something nearby
value.description: Asha notices Lucia checking the cardigan pocket and drawer, and understands the key's secret is already in the room with them.
evidence: Lucia's fingers went to the cardigan pocket again, empty now, and then to a low drawer under the machine, and Asha understood that whatever the key opened was already in this room with them.

value.name: Lucia reveals hidden velvet case
value.description: Lucia opens a low drawer and exposes a flat blue velvet case hidden behind household items.
evidence: Lucia knelt and drew the low drawer open along its warped runner, and Asha saw at the back of it, behind a tin of buttons and a folded length of muslin, a flat blue velvet case the size of a hand.

value.name: Lucia asks Asha to open the case
value.description: Lucia does not touch the case herself, instead signaling that Asha should be the one to handle it.
evidence: Lucia did not lift it out herself; she sat back on her heels and looked up, and Asha understood she was being asked to be the one whose fingerprints went on it.

value.name: Asha unlocks the velvet case
value.description: Asha sets down her folder, takes out the silver key, and unlocks the brass lock on the case.
evidence: Asha set the folder down on the chair beside the machine and brought the silver key out of her fist, the tarnish warm now from her palm, and fitted it into the small brass lock on the long edge of the case.
It turned with the soft give of something that had not been opened in a while but had been oiled within memory

value.name: Daniel calls from behind the door
value.description: Daniel's voice comes through the closed door, calling Asha's name, but neither woman responds.
evidence: and from below Daniel's voice came again through the closed door, indistinct through the wood but unmistakably her name.

value.name: Asha opens the case
value.description: With Lucia steadying herself, Asha lifts the lid of the case.
evidence: Lucia's hand went to the edge of the drawer to steady herself, and Asha lifted the lid.

value.name: Asha finds garnets and earrings
value.description: Inside the case, Asha sees a string of garnets and a pair of earrings on blue silk.
evidence: Inside the case, on a bed of dulled blue silk, lay a thin string of garnets and a pair of earrings Asha did not look at twice

value.name: Lucia reacts emotionally to the jewelry
value.description: Lucia closes her eyes briefly in response to the contents of the case, showing a private emotional reaction.
evidence: Lucia closed her eyes for a breath
